== Notes ==
* The concise description is correct: only physical ''attack'' damage triggers this skill. Other sources of physical damage (e.g. [[Ursan Strike]]) do not.
* Synergizes well with [[scythe]]s, as well as [[Attack#Skills dealing multiple attacks|attack skills that can deal multiple attacks]].
* [[Yayoi of the Orders]] is an ally, but getting him killed by enemies during the [[Redemption for the Lost]] quest allows you to capture the skill.
